articles.title: DNA repair enzymes favor specific sequences, shaping mutation patterns in the human genome
articles.desc: When a wound does not heal properly, it leaves a scar. Similarly, mutations—which are permanent changes to genetic code—are often the result of damaged DNA that has not been properly repaired. Scientists still do not fully understand why some damaged DNA segments are successfully repaired while others are not.

articles.desc: The high cost of platinum is one of the main barriers to the wider adoption of hydrogen fuel cells. articles.title: 'Flying focus' laser overcomes key limitation in plasma-based particle accelerators
articles.desc: In a new Nature Physics study, researchers accelerated electrons to more than twice the energy predicted by the traditional dephasing limit for laser-plasma accelerators operating over the same distance. This was made possible by a specially engineered laser pulse called a flying focus, which counteracts a longstanding limitation known as "dephasing."
